metrics.name: episode_sensitivity
metrics.definition: hit episodes / episodes; an episode is hit iff a label-eligible, policy-queried reading in its warning window has state ALERT. L1 episode (ANALYSIS_PLAN §0); H = 60 min; correct warning window [onset-60, onset-15]

metrics.name: fa_per_patient_day
metrics.definition: FALSE notifications / sum of monitored days (first to last CGM reading per recording). Notification = ALERT with no notification in the previous 60 min; FALSE = no onset in (t, t+60] and the record continues >= 60 min

metrics.name: outcome_unknown_notifications
metrics.definition: notifications with no onset in (t, t+60] whose recording ends before t+60; excluded from TRUE and FALSE, reported separately

metrics.name: alert_precision
metrics.definition: TRUE / (TRUE + FALSE); OUTCOME-UNKNOWN excluded

metrics.name: operating_curve
metrics.definition: (FA/day, sensitivity) at every distinct queried score, strictest first, sentinel +inf; exact policy replay; non-monotone FA steps counted

metrics.name: sens_at_1fa
metrics.definition: first-crossing interpolation at B = 1.0 FA/patient-day (flags budget_not_reached, k_star_is_1)

metrics.name: delta_sens_at_1fa
metrics.definition: sens@1FA(A) - sens@1FA(B) on the same patients; paired patient-cluster bootstrap (B = 2,000, seed 2027, percentile 95 %)

metrics.name: tau_alert
metrics.definition: τA = threshold at the last point before the first crossing of 1.0 FA/day on DEVELOPMENT predictions

metrics.name: tau_watch
metrics.definition: τW = same rule on the total notification rate (TRUE+FALSE+UNKNOWN) with B = 3.0; τW := min(τW, τA)

metrics.name: partial_area_0.5_2.0
metrics.definition: trapezoidal area under S(F) along the first-crossing path, clipped to [0.5, 2.0] FA/day (signed over non-monotone stretches), normalised by 1.5

metrics.name: lead_time
metrics.definition: onset - earliest ALERT in the warning window (hit episodes): median, IQR, share >= 30 min

metrics.name: missed_episode_rate
metrics.definition: 1 - episode sensitivity; reported with the warnable ceiling

metrics.name: warnable_ceiling
metrics.definition: share of episodes with a label-eligible time in [onset-60, onset-15] (S2 definition, labels.eligibility.warnable_onsets)

metrics.name: per_patient_distribution
metrics.definition: per-patient sensitivity and FA/day (quartiles; forest plot input). Development data only before freeze

metrics.name: abstention_coverage
metrics.definition: share of CGM readings in INSUFFICIENT DATA; warnable episodes with no forecast at any label-eligible window reading

metrics.name: log_loss
metrics.definition: mean -[y log p + (1-y) log(1-p)] over label-eligible times (p clipped 1e-15)

metrics.name: brier
metrics.definition: mean (p - y)^2 over label-eligible times

metrics.name: auprc
metrics.definition: average precision over label-eligible times

metrics.name: ece
metrics.definition: sum over 10 equal-count bins of n_b/N |mean p - mean y|

metrics.name: calibration_slope_intercept
metrics.definition: logistic regression of y on logit(p), unpenalised

metrics.name: bootstrap_undefined_resamples
metrics.definition: resamples in which a statistic is undefined (no episodes); G5 requires episodes in every resample
